entities.summary: Hina Rabbani Khar is a Pakistani politician who served as Minister of State for Foreign Affairs from 2022 to 2023. She previously served as Foreign Minister of Pakistan from July 2011, the first and only woman to hold the position, and was a member of the National Assembly from 2018 to 2023.
